company.name: Emerge Career
company.shortDescription: Emerge Career platform offers vocational training for people released from prison to get immediate jobs.
company.description: Emerge Career platform offers vocational training for people released from prison to get immediate jobs. Emerge Career provides training programs for government agencies looking to create high-paying jobs, reduce recidivism, and lift incarcerated people out of poverty. Emerge Career matches students with partner schools for accelerated hands-on training and eventually connects graduates with a network of employers.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that manages the entire workforce development cycle from recruitment to job retention for low-income and justice-impacted individuals.
